actions.reason: Back-feed B28, B29, B31, B32, B33 from Feeder F4 (B25) through tie B25–B29

checks.detail: Soft preference; reported, never used to reject

checks.name: Faulted section isolated
checks.limit: faulted line disconnected from every source

checks.value: PU-1 running (min 0.918 pu), PU-2 running (min 0.935 pu)
checks.limit: claimed pumps run; no undervoltage trip (< 0.90 pu)
checks.detail: Pump runs only if its bus is energised and V ≥ 0.90 pu

verification.method: Independent re-solve: both networks rebuilt from district.json through a separate code path (pandapower model assembled element-by-element from benchmark impedances; EPANET 2.2 input file generated as text and loaded through WNTR's INP reader); the full switching sequence replayed from the normal configuration; AC Newton–Raphson power flow and extended-period hydraulics (60 s step) re-solved every frame of the remaining horizon with an independent pump-availability fixed point. 'Simulation Verified' means every hard check passed in this re-simulation of the synthetic model; it is not a field certification.

rationale: Highest grid-only score among 13 admissible feasible candidates (9.31): conventional restoration maximises restored electrical energy and never interrupts customers who still have supply.

Grid-only accounting: City Hospital's 150 kW genset-supplied load counts as already served, so re-energising B32 is worth only 84 kW; PS-2 (B33) is an ordinary 86 kW load whose water service is outside the objective.
Restores 687 kW at switching and sheds 222 kW (B30): net +464 kW; 2 switching operation(s).
Sheds 222 kW by leaving B30 (District Cooling Plant DC-1, 200 kW / 600 kVAr) off, so the rest of the de-energised area can be restored within every hard limit.
PU-2 back in service: tank storage stays ≥ 37% and critical-facility pressure ≥ 37.1 m for the rest of the horizon.
Worst evaluated voltage 0.911 pu (hard limit 0.90 pu); peak line loading 91%.

70 candidates rejected on hard constraints, e.g. C02 — V(B28)=0.671 pu < 0.90 pu at 19:00; C03 — Line B25–B29 (SW-25-29) loaded 165% > 100% of its 46 A rating at 19:00; C04 — V(B28)=0.690 pu < 0.90 pu at 19:00.
Independent verification: 8/8 hard checks passed (Simulation Verified).
assumptions: Synthetic district on the IEEE 33-bus benchmark; ratings, pump curves and demand profiles are declared assumptions.
Loads are constant-power and follow the declared time-of-day profile; pump demand comes from the hydraulic solution.
A pump runs only if its bus is energised and V ≥ 0.90 pu (latching undervoltage trip).
Switching is executed remotely at the switching time; the faulted section stays isolated for the horizon.
Gensets carry essential electrical load only; they do not power pumping stations.
Grid-only objective: maximise restored electrical energy; facilities on backup generation count as served; pumps are ordinary loads; water ignored.
